# Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) Checklist: Dynamic Survey Viewer

**Purpose**: Validate that the accessibility requirements are complete against WCAG 2.1 AA — which
includes every Level A criterion — and that each is written so a test or an audit can decide it. The
constitution binds this feature to AA (Principle V), so a criterion with no requirement is a gap in the
spec, not an implementation detail.
**Created**: 2026-10-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [.specify/memory/constitution.md](../../../.specify/memory/constitution.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Author's review pass**: items CHK011 and CHK013 failed on 2026-10-08. CHK011 is fixed by FR-077;
CHK013 is a criterion this feature cannot meet with the current JSON contract and is now recorded as a
documented limitation with a removal plan, as Governance requires — see
[Checklist review](../spec.md#checklist-review--session-2026-10-08) and §Assumptions.

## Perceivable

- [ ] CHK001 Is a programmatic label required for every control, and a labelled group for every grouped control? [Completeness, Spec §FR-053]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it required that no state is conveyed by colour alone, with the text alternative named rather than implied? [Clarity, Spec §FR-057]
- [ ] CHK003 Are contrast ratios stated as numbers for both text and non-text UI, rather than as "accessible"? [Measurability, Spec §FR-057]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the `satisfaction` scale required to carry visible text labels rather than icons alone? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the `rating` control's rendering decided for the case where a star cannot represent the value (`scale.min: 0`)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-009]

## Operable

- [ ] CHK006 Is full keyboard operation required for every flow, with no keyboard trap, and is that measurable end to end? [Measurability, Spec §FR-056, §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK007 Is a visible focus indicator required, and is its visibility stated against its background rather than as a bare presence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-056]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the focus destination specified for every navigation and every blocked navigation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-029, §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK009 Are target-size requirements stated for controls whose label is an icon or a single character? [Gap, Spec §FR-058]

## Understandable

- [ ] CHK010 Are error messages required to be in respondent language and to name the rule and its number? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, §FR-069]
- [ ] CHK011 Does a requirement exist for a document title per screen (criterion 2.4.2) and a declared page language (criterion 3.1.1), both Level A and therefore inside AA? [Gap, Spec §FR-053..FR-059] — **failed; fixed by FR-077**
- [ ] CHK012 Is the error wording required to be derivable from the contract, so no survey config can ship an unexplained or untranslated message? [Consistency, Spec §FR-069]
- [ ] CHK013 Is criterion 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose addressed for the fixture's name question, either by a requirement or by a recorded limitation with a removal plan? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions] — **failed; now recorded as a documented limitation, not met**

## Robust — announcements and state

- [ ] CHK014 Is the politeness level specified for every announcement, with validation and submission failures assertive and progress announcements polite? [Completeness, Spec §FR-055]
- [ ] CHK015 Is `aria-invalid` plus `aria-describedby` required on an invalid control, so the error is read with the control rather than only in a summary? [Completeness, Spec §FR-054]
- [ ] CHK016 Is an announcement required for each attachment added and removed? [Coverage, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the accessible presentation of every one of the eight viewer states specified, not only the error states? [Coverage, Spec §FR-045]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the catalog's states given the same treatment as the viewer's, including the busy announcement while loading? [Coverage, Spec §FR-074]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Does the automated accessibility criterion name the screens it covers and the widths it runs at? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK020 Does the spec state which AA criteria an automated check cannot decide, so a green run is not mistaken for conformance? [Clarity, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK021 Are the error, not-found and submission-error screens inside the accessibility criterion's scope, not only the happy path? [Coverage, Spec §SC-009]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK013 is expected to remain unticked for this feature; it is tracked by the removal plan under §Assumptions, not by this box
